comment: Minimum working topology for the publish service: ONE pending-builds queue and nothing else. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH -- RabbitMQ imports it at boot (load_definitions in rabbitmq.conf), so the application must never declare topology itself. There are deliberately no exchanges: publishers use the default exchange with the routing key set to the queue name (basic_publish($msg, '', 'q.builds')). This is a starting point, not the final topology -- results, dead-lettering and unrouted-message handling are expected to arrive later. Queue and exchange arguments are IMMUTABLE once created: a re-import silently keeps the existing definition, so any change here needs the broker recreated with a wiped docker/rabbitMQ-data.
